title: Domain.com Hosting Review 2026: Plans, Prices and Renewals
excerpt: A Domain.com hosting review from its own pages and HostAdvice: plan prices, renewals, support findings, builder and pros and cons.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Domain.com hosting review for 2026: plan prices and renewals, HostAdvice findings on support, builder and AI claims, pros and cons, and who it suits.
meta.rl_answer: Domain.com is simple to start and costly to keep. Renewal is about three times the first-year price.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Domain.com good for hosting? | It is simple to start. Renewal is about three times the first-year price, and we found no speed test.
How much does Domain.com hosting cost? | Starter is $35.88 for the first year and $105.99 a year at renewal.
Does Domain.com have a free trial or guarantee? | The hosting page lists a 99% uptime guarantee. We did not find a money-back guarantee.
Is Domain.com the same as Network Solutions? | HostAdvice noted that Domain.com support appears under the Network Solutions brand.
Does Domain.com have an AI website builder? | HostAdvice lists one on all plans. Our read of the hosting page did not. Check the live page.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Starter is $35.88 for the first year and $105.99 at renewal.
Renewal is 2.7 to 3.1 times the first-year price.
HostAdvice found chat starts with bot prompts, then a human.
We found no speed or uptime test.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
Renewal price | The price after the first term.
Uptime guarantee | A promise about how often the site is online.
Drag and drop builder | A tool where you place items on a page with the mouse.
VPS | A virtual private server with its own resources.
